card.name: Punctuation in transporter interaction text
card.fires_on: Small punctuation or linking tokens in drug-interaction passages about transporter substrates (BCRP, OAT1, OATP) and kidney-function cutoffs. It fires on the period in section numbers like 7.2, on commas or brackets after example drugs, and on the space before a number.

modes.label: Section number period
modes.description: The period inside a cross-reference such as (7.2) at the end of an interaction statement.

modes.label: Punctuation in substrate lists
modes.description: Commas, brackets, "of" or "e.g.," just before or inside a list of example substrate drugs.

modes.label: Space before kidney cutoff
modes.description: The space just before a number in an eGFR or creatinine clearance threshold.

card.writes: It promotes odd code and name pieces and suppresses toxicity and metabolism words, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks small punctuation spots in drug-interaction and kidney-dosing text, where a list item or number comes next.
